# Ko-fi triggers

## Commission

Runs when someone pays for a Ko-fi commission (a custom piece of work). Needs your Ko-fi webhook set up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who supported you ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%url%` | A web link to the Ko-fi page of this support |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `kofi.commission`</small>

## Resubscription

Runs when a Ko-fi member pays again for their membership. Needs your Ko-fi webhook set up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tier name** | Only run for this membership level, like "Gold". Type it as it appears on your page. Leave empty for any level. |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who supported you ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%url%` | A web link to the Ko-fi page of this support |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%tier%` | Their membership level |

<small>Type id: `kofi.resubscription`</small>

## Shop Order

Runs when someone buys from your Ko-fi shop. Handy to thank buyers on stream. Needs your Ko-fi webhook set up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who supported you ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%url%` | A web link to the Ko-fi page of this support |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%itemCount%` | How many different items were ordered |
| `%item0%` | The first item's name (use item1, item2... for the next ones) |
| `%item0.quantity%` | How many of the first item |

<small>Type id: `kofi.shopOrder`</small>
